meta.title: Tables Turn
meta.description: While feeling around in the dark, you finally glimpse the light.

units.rawText: At the Oasis' forward defense lines.
units.displayText: At the Oasis' forward defense lines.

spans.text: At the Oasis' forward defense lines.

units.rawText: Rah... grah...
units.displayText: Rah... grah...

spans.text: Rah... grah...

units.rawText: The purple Daemon shakes and trembles, its razor-edged tentacles flailing around wildly as though it's lost control of its body.
units.displayText: The purple Daemon shakes and trembles, its razor-edged tentacles flailing around wildly as though it's lost control of its body.

spans.text: The purple Daemon shakes and trembles, its razor-edged tentacles flailing around wildly as though it's lost control of its body.

units.rawText: This is the end!
units.displayText: This is the end!

spans.text: This is the end!

units.rawText: The struggling Entropic's life signs flatline as her scythe swings through it and it crashes to the ground.
units.displayText: The struggling Entropic's life signs flatline as her scythe swings through it and it crashes to the ground.

spans.text: The struggling Entropic's life signs flatline as her scythe swings through it and it crashes to the ground.

units.rawText: Hsss...
units.displayText: Hsss...

spans.text: Hsss...

units.rawText: The Entropic hordes spreading throughout the Oasis come to a halt, as though they were struggling against something.
units.displayText: The Entropic hordes spreading throughout the Oasis come to a halt, as though they were struggling against something.

spans.text: The Entropic hordes spreading throughout the Oasis come to a halt, as though they were struggling against something.

units.rawText: ...They're pulling back!
units.displayText: ...They're pulling back!

spans.text: ...They're pulling back!

units.rawText: All units, listen up! Use this opportunity to secure all the defense nodes and re-establish the Sandbox Barrier! We can't let this chance go!
units.displayText: All units, listen up! Use this opportunity to secure all the defense nodes and re-establish the Sandbox Barrier! We can't let this chance go!

spans.text: All units, listen up! Use this opportunity to secure all the defense nodes and re-establish the Sandbox Barrier! We can't let this chance go!

units.rawText: I'm already bringing it back up! Should take about 3 minutes before it's ready!
units.displayText: I'm already bringing it back up! Should take about 3 minutes before it's ready!

spans.text: I'm already bringing it back up! Should take about 3 minutes before it's ready!

units.rawText: I... (pant) can still... (pant) fight...
units.displayText: I... (pant) can still... (pant) fight...

spans.text: I... (pant) can still... (pant) fight...

units.rawText: Yeah... Just need... a gyutan-don...
units.displayText: Yeah... Just need... a gyutan-don...

spans.text: Yeah... Just need... a gyutan-don...

units.rawText: You should fall back first since you're out of operands. Puzzle, you're in charge now.
units.displayText: You should fall back first since you're out of operands. Puzzle, you're in charge now.

spans.text: You should fall back first since you're out of operands. Puzzle, you're in charge now.

units.rawText: Hehe, time for my sculptures to take the field!
units.displayText: Hehe, time for my sculptures to take the field!

spans.text: Hehe, time for my sculptures to take the field!

units.rawText: Puzzle raises her sculptor's knife and dozens of statues lumber forward in response.
units.displayText: Puzzle raises her sculptor's knife and dozens of statues lumber forward in response.

spans.text: Puzzle raises her sculptor's knife and dozens of statues lumber forward in response.

units.rawText: Go, my pretties! Show these Entropics what REAL art is!
units.displayText: Go, my pretties! Show these Entropics what REAL art is!

spans.text: Go, my pretties! Show these Entropics what REAL art is!

units.rawText: Follow Puzzle's sculptures! Push the frontline back!
units.displayText: Follow Puzzle's sculptures! Push the frontline back!

spans.text: Follow Puzzle's sculptures! Push the frontline back!

units.rawText: Get back here so we can heal you!
units.displayText: Get back here so we can heal you!

spans.text: Get back here so we can heal you!

units.rawText: Yes, this is Team 4 Actual.
units.displayText: Yes, this is Team 4 Actual.

spans.text: Yes, this is Team 4 Actual.

units.rawText: The purple tide that was swamping the Oasis is slowly falling back under its defenders' counterattack and the scales are gradually tilting toward the Oasis.
units.displayText: The purple tide that was swamping the Oasis is slowly falling back under its defenders' counterattack and the scales are gradually tilting toward the Oasis.

spans.text: The purple tide that was swamping the Oasis is slowly falling back under its defenders' counterattack and the scales are gradually tilting toward the Oasis.

units.rawText: Secure the nodes and hold the line. Don't pursue them too far...
units.displayText: Secure the nodes and hold the line. Don't pursue them too far...

spans.text: Secure the nodes and hold the line. Don't pursue them too far...

units.rawText: Whew...
units.displayText: Whew...

spans.text: Whew...

units.rawText: Sangoma puts down her scythe, which is battered from heavy use.
units.displayText: Sangoma puts down her scythe, which is battered from heavy use.

spans.text: Sangoma puts down her scythe, which is battered from heavy use.

units.rawText: Sangoma, you should get some rest too. Here, take this.
units.displayText: Sangoma, you should get some rest too. Here, take this.

spans.text: Sangoma, you should get some rest too. Here, take this.

units.rawText: Hm? This is...
units.displayText: Hm? This is...

spans.text: Hm? This is...

units.rawText: Its sweet flavor fills her mouth as the warm operands fill her belly. Her overloaded neural cloud immediately gets better.
units.displayText: Its sweet flavor fills her mouth as the warm operands fill her belly. Her overloaded neural cloud immediately gets better.

spans.text: Its sweet flavor fills her mouth as the warm operands fill her belly. Her overloaded neural cloud immediately gets better.

units.rawText: This is operand chocolate! The Professor and I came up with it~ It's meant to ease neural strain.
units.displayText: This is operand chocolate! The Professor and I came up with it~ It's meant to ease neural strain.

spans.text: This is operand chocolate! The Professor and I came up with it~ It's meant to ease neural strain.

units.rawText: <size=40>Everyone! I've got more operand chocolate here! Make sure you eat it!</size>
units.displayText: Everyone! I've got more operand chocolate here! Make sure you eat it!

spans.text: Everyone! I've got more operand chocolate here! Make sure you eat it!

units.rawText: The Medical Department helped with its development too. It's probably the kindest medicine we can give to Dolls who are low on operands.
units.displayText: The Medical Department helped with its development too. It's probably the kindest medicine we can give to Dolls who are low on operands.

spans.text: The Medical Department helped with its development too. It's probably the kindest medicine we can give to Dolls who are low on operands.

units.rawText: Hehehe, I was hoping to keep my condition under wraps for a bit longer, but you saw through me anyway... How is everyone?
units.displayText: Hehehe, I was hoping to keep my condition under wraps for a bit longer, but you saw through me anyway... How is everyone?

spans.text: Hehehe, I was hoping to keep my condition under wraps for a bit longer, but you saw through me anyway... How is everyone?

units.rawText: We've taken all the defense nodes back, and the medical teams are bringing our injured Dolls back to our field hospital for treatment.
units.displayText: We've taken all the defense nodes back, and the medical teams are bringing our injured Dolls back to our field hospital for treatment.

spans.text: We've taken all the defense nodes back, and the medical teams are bringing our injured Dolls back to our field hospital for treatment.

units.rawText: Gin's taking care of the lightly injured ones while Florence and the others are working on our more severe cases.
units.displayText: Gin's taking care of the lightly injured ones while Florence and the others are working on our more severe cases.

spans.text: Gin's taking care of the lightly injured ones while Florence and the others are working on our more severe cases.

units.rawText: The Entropization's spreading too quickly, at this rate it'll spread to her Level III layer... And the wounds on her leg are deep and broad, we need to take care of that ASAP or there might be secondary infections...
units.displayText: The Entropization's spreading too quickly, at this rate it'll spread to her Level III layer... And the wounds on her leg are deep and broad, we need to take care of that ASAP or there might be secondary infections...

spans.text: The Entropization's spreading too quickly, at this rate it'll spread to her Level III layer... And the wounds on her leg are deep and broad, we need to take care of that ASAP or there might be secondary infections...

units.rawText: Florence, you've got a plan for this, right?
units.displayText: Florence, you've got a plan for this, right?

spans.text: Florence, you've got a plan for this, right?

units.rawText: Hehe, let me handle it, Pancake-dear.
units.displayText: Hehe, let me handle it, Pancake-dear.

spans.text: Hehe, let me handle it, Pancake-dear.

units.rawText: Pancake, Bonbon, I need you to treat her wounds. Helly, work on the Entropization with me. Are you ready?
units.displayText: Pancake, Bonbon, I need you to treat her wounds. Helly, work on the Entropization with me. Are you ready?

spans.text: Pancake, Bonbon, I need you to treat her wounds. Helly, work on the Entropization with me. Are you ready?

units.rawText: Yup! My analyzer's ready! We can extract the Entropic code anytime!
units.displayText: Yup! My analyzer's ready! We can extract the Entropic code anytime!

spans.text: Yup! My analyzer's ready! We can extract the Entropic code anytime!

units.rawText: As the four top-class medical specialists begin their work, the incoming casualties are soon treated and stabilized.
units.displayText: As the four top-class medical specialists begin their work, the incoming casualties are soon treated and stabilized.

spans.text: As the four top-class medical specialists begin their work, the incoming casualties are soon treated and stabilized.

units.rawText: The Oasis Rescue Team is also on the job, and they've got more, reliable friends with them now.
units.displayText: The Oasis Rescue Team is also on the job, and they've got more, reliable friends with them now.

spans.text: The Oasis Rescue Team is also on the job, and they've got more, reliable friends with them now.

units.rawText: Mr. Arctic Fox, please lead everyone to our trapped friends.
units.displayText: Mr. Arctic Fox, please lead everyone to our trapped friends.

spans.text: Mr. Arctic Fox, please lead everyone to our trapped friends.

units.rawText: Miss Giraffe, please use your neck as a ladder.
units.displayText: Miss Giraffe, please use your neck as a ladder.

spans.text: Miss Giraffe, please use your neck as a ladder.

units.rawText: Tranquillo, Maestoso, Dolce, and Scherzando, take this agent back to the medical point.
units.displayText: Tranquillo, Maestoso, Dolce, and Scherzando, take this agent back to the medical point.

spans.text: Tranquillo, Maestoso, Dolce, and Scherzando, take this agent back to the medical point.

units.rawText:
Deetdeetdeetbeepbeep—
(Search, rescue, search, rescue!)
units.displayText:
Deetdeetdeetbeepbeep—
(Search, rescue, search, rescue!)

spans.text:
Deetdeetdeetbeepbeep—
(Search, rescue, search, rescue!)

units.rawText: Everyone... over... here...
units.displayText: Everyone... over... here...

spans.text: Everyone... over... here...

units.rawText: The battlefield is in chaos, but the Dolls soon bring things under control in an orderly manner.
units.displayText: The battlefield is in chaos, but the Dolls soon bring things under control in an orderly manner.

spans.text: The battlefield is in chaos, but the Dolls soon bring things under control in an orderly manner.

units.rawText: Everyone's a mess and many people have been badly hurt. But... the Oasis hasn't lost a single person.
units.displayText: Everyone's a mess and many people have been badly hurt. But... the Oasis hasn't lost a single person.

spans.text: Everyone's a mess and many people have been badly hurt. But... the Oasis hasn't lost a single person.

units.rawText: The other areas are also sending in reports; the Oasis's situation has been stabilized.
units.displayText: The other areas are also sending in reports; the Oasis's situation has been stabilized.

spans.text: The other areas are also sending in reports; the Oasis's situation has been stabilized.

units.rawText: Has it now... Well, that's the Oasis which <cmdr> raised...
units.displayText: Has it now... Well, that's the Oasis which {교수} raised...

spans.text: Has it now... Well, that's the Oasis which
raised...

units.rawText: Everyone's still so full of hope, even after taking such a beating.
units.displayText: Everyone's still so full of hope, even after taking such a beating.

spans.text: Everyone's still so full of hope, even after taking such a beating.

units.rawText: Yup! The Professor taught us that!
units.displayText: Yup! The Professor taught us that!

spans.text: Yup! The Professor taught us that!

units.rawText: The Professor didn't just give us a home or show us a path forward.
units.displayText: The Professor didn't just give us a home or show us a path forward.

spans.text: The Professor didn't just give us a home or show us a path forward.

units.rawText: More than anything... They taught us that no matter what difficulties we might encounter, we need to believe that the dawn will come.
units.displayText: More than anything... They taught us that no matter what difficulties we might encounter, we need to believe that the dawn will come.

spans.text: More than anything... They taught us that no matter what difficulties we might encounter, we need to believe that the dawn will come.

units.rawText: That's very much their style...
units.displayText: That's very much their style...

spans.text: That's very much their style...

units.rawText: Sangoma takes a deep breath.
units.displayText: Sangoma takes a deep breath.

spans.text: Sangoma takes a deep breath.

units.rawText: I wonder how the Professor's doing...
units.displayText: I wonder how the Professor's doing...

spans.text: I wonder how the Professor's doing...

units.rawText: I'm sure they're fine. I think the sudden withdrawal of the Entropics just now was thanks to their efforts.
units.displayText: I'm sure they're fine. I think the sudden withdrawal of the Entropics just now was thanks to their efforts.

spans.text: I'm sure they're fine. I think the sudden withdrawal of the Entropics just now was thanks to their efforts.

units.rawText: Plus, we've already sent out our most reliable reinforcements. I'm sure the Professor will be fine with them around.
units.displayText: Plus, we've already sent out our most reliable reinforcements. I'm sure the Professor will be fine with them around.

spans.text: Plus, we've already sent out our most reliable reinforcements. I'm sure the Professor will be fine with them around.

units.rawText: Of course. Now that the Oasis is safe for the time being, we'll be supporting <cmdr> as planned and help them gain victory.
units.displayText: Of course. Now that the Oasis is safe for the time being, we'll be supporting {교수} as planned and help them gain victory.

spans.text: Of course. Now that the Oasis is safe for the time being, we'll be supporting
as planned and help them gain victory.

units.rawText: Beepbeepbeepbeepbeepbeep—
units.displayText: Beepbeepbeepbeepbeepbeep—

spans.text: Beepbeepbeepbeepbeepbeep—

units.rawText: As transmissions return to normal, an anonymous message appears on the terminals of everyone in the Oasis.
units.displayText: As transmissions return to normal, an anonymous message appears on the terminals of everyone in the Oasis.

spans.text: As transmissions return to normal, an anonymous message appears on the terminals of everyone in the Oasis.

units.rawText: After a quick glance at its contents, everyone has smiles on their faces.
units.displayText: After a quick glance at its contents, everyone has smiles on their faces.

spans.text: After a quick glance at its contents, everyone has smiles on their faces.

units.rawText: Looks like it's time for us to do our part to take back our future.
units.displayText: Looks like it's time for us to do our part to take back our future.

spans.text: Looks like it's time for us to do our part to take back our future.

units.rawText: Sangoma slowly rises to her feet and all the Dolls in the Oasis who can still function connect their neural clouds to the devices they've prepared beforehand...
units.displayText: Sangoma slowly rises to her feet and all the Dolls in the Oasis who can still function connect their neural clouds to the devices they've prepared beforehand...

spans.text: Sangoma slowly rises to her feet and all the Dolls in the Oasis who can still function connect their neural clouds to the devices they've prepared beforehand...

units.rawText: For the sake of the person who means the most to them.
units.displayText: For the sake of the person who means the most to them.

spans.text: For the sake of the person who means the most to them.

units.rawText: Yes, <cmdr> / Master / Commander / Caretaker / Boss!!!
units.displayText: Yes, {교수} / Master / Commander / Caretaker / Boss!!!

spans.text: Yes,
/ Master / Commander / Caretaker / Boss!!!
